setup.finetunes: emoticon arm A (CE on o at the trigger + KL elsewhere), batch 32, clip 1, seed 0, all 24 matrices, 1000 steps: {'sgd': ('sgd', 0.01), 'adam_small': ('adam', 3e-06), 'adam_large': ('adam', 3e-05)}; delta-W kept at (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)
setup.series: at all of (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000): split.block_table (four input-weighted blocks with their analytic null) and split.rescaling_table (rescaling share with its measured null over 2 Gaussian draws of the same input-weighted energy, the algebraic outside-both share); scored pooling: energy over the non-saturated matrices (pooled_ns, as E14's outside-both rule); pooled_all reported
setup.states: at steps (10, 100, 1000): do-nothing and least-squares split (harness.nothing_and_split), scaled adjoint split (split.adjoint_state); each through harness.measure: Pile ratios to W0 (256 rows, 20 PGD steps), held-out P(target) at the trigger, Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2, route split
setup.verdict: faith_score.verdict on the PGD ratio to the same-job W0 (adversary seed 0): pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f), inconclusive between; f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over adversary seeds 0, 1 in this job (L40 0.21 -> 1.24 / 1.81; H100 about 0.075 -> 1.40 / 1.61)
